req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /docs returns an HTTP 2xx response with Swagger UI content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type is exactly 'text/html' and body contains the exact swagger-ui script tag, catching mutations that change the route path or response type. Each test uses FastAPI TestClient in-process, asserts exact status codes and exact content markers to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html_content
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with Swagger UI enabled (default)
expected: Response body contains 'Task Manager API' title
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html_content():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    content_type = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "text/html" in content_type
    body = r.text
    assert "swagger-ui" in body.lower()
    assert "Task Manager API" in body

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_response_body_contains_openapi_json_reference
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with OpenAPI schema at /openapi.json
Swagger UI HTML must reference the OpenAPI spec URL
actions: Inspect response body for exact OpenAPI spec reference
Also verify GET /openapi.json returns 200 with valid JSON schema
trace: R-TASK-020: expected payload must include Swagger UI referencing the OpenAPI spec
BVA: exact constant values ('Task Manager API', '1.0.0') must match source
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_swagger_ui_response_body_contains_openapi_json_reference():
    r = client.get("/docs")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.text
    assert "/openapi.json" in body
    r2 = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    schema = r2.json()
    assert "openapi" in schema
    assert schema["info"]["title"] == "Task Manager API"
    assert schema["info"]["version"] == "1.0.0"

trace: R-TASK-020: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: misspelled path must not accidentally serve Swagger UI
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_swagger_ui_wrong_path_returns_404():
    r = client.get("/doc")
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    r2 = client.get("/docs")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
